create.intro: A team workspace keeps your team's apps in a private GitHub repository. Each person works on their own copy, and a pipeline publishes the apps to Microsoft Fabric with a deploy identity that Fabricator creates for you.

create.repoInvalid: Enter the repository as owner/name, for example contoso/sales-apps, or paste its GitHub address.
create.repoHintChoose: Choose one of your repositories, or enter owner/name. It must be private or internal, and you need the Maintain or Admin role on it. If you can't create one, an owner of your organization can create it for you.
create.repoHintEnter: Enter owner/name, or paste the repository’s GitHub address. It must be private or internal, and you need the Maintain or Admin role on it. If you can't create one, an owner of your organization can create it for you.
create.ownerLocked: {{owner}} doesn’t let you create repositories. Ask one of its owners to create an empty private repository for the workspace and give you the Maintain role, then use it as an existing repository.
create.ownerHint: Fabricator creates a private repository. Use an organization if your team already has one.

create.capacityHint: Fabricator creates two Fabric workspaces on it: one for published apps and one for everyone's previews.
